Pressure Rate is defined as the ratio of pressured plays to total plays. Mathematically, it maps the binary outcome of pressure (yes/no) into a continuous [0,1] interval, providing a normalized summary statistic. Its dual nature emerges through its use: as a descriptive statistic in GSI, it updates beliefs about QB performance; as a transition probability in GSE, it governs state-chains of quarterback actions. Failure occurs when charting errors introduce bias, leading to spurious correlations with other metrics.
